description: This Kotlin source file defines the VoiceWakeManager class, which manages speech recognition for voice wake word detection and command recognition in an Android application. It handles starting/stopping speech recognition, processing transcriptions, and triggering callbacks when wake commands are recognized.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Manages voice wake word detection and speech recognition, including starting/stopping recognition, handling recognition results, and triggering commands.

methods.name: setTriggerWords
methods.description: Sets the list of trigger words that activate voice commands.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops speech recognition and updates status.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Internal method to initiate listening with configured intent.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules restarting recognition after a delay, used to handle errors or end of speech.

methods.name: handleTranscription
methods.description: Processes recognized transcribed text to detect wake commands and triggers callback.
